scenicChapters.title: Apache Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: For 18 km this is Apache Trail, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Apache Trail
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

sections.advice: Vlore → Llogara Pass climbs about 1027 m in 39 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Llogara Pass → Dhermi drops about 1027 m over 8 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Dhermi → Himare is 13 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Himare → Porto Palermo is 7 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Porto Palermo → Sarande is 35 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Vlore → Llogara Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 70 km. 1027 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Albanian Riviera, SH8
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 1027 m come off over 15 km at around 12.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Albanian Riviera, SH8

scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

albanian-riviera-sh8.story: From Vlorë it runs 185 km to Sarandë; allow about 2 h 29 of riding. The stops in between: Llogara Pass, Dhermi, Himare and Porto Palermo. The highest point is about 1,050 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
